scientific_integrity: Proof is stated for every finite nonempty poset and prime-power field; numerical verification covers six explicitly listed small cases and is not promoted to an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: All results concern maximal commuting idempotent subsemigroups in finite-field incidence monoids, not general commuting subsemigroups. Statistical data do not recover poset orientation. Completeness is mathematical for the stated domain; literature priority is not exhaustively established and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Tutte laws for intersections of maximal commuting idempotent semilattices of incidence monoids
